collection.title: Citroen C4 Hatchback (Not Cactus Model) 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C4 Hatchback 2020 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 16" on the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
